full_page.content:
St. Bonaventure Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Mich. July 18th, 1944
Miss Grace Panyard.
God bless you Grace and many thanks for your favor. I've mis- laid your letter just for the moment; but before neglecting it further and then forgetting I am just sending this card that Br. Rufin started.
Please give "Best Regards" to George and and to Mother especially and to Doris. I hope these latter will enjoy their trip to Wisconsin and get back in good shape. Thank Doris also for her favor of last week.
God bless you all again.
Sincerely in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
